title: Holomorphy of the ground state and energy for bosonic quadratic Hamiltonians
summary: We study the holomorphy of the ground state and its energy with respect to the coupling constant for bosonic quadratic Hamiltonians. We prove general theorems establishing this holomorphy, thereby providing a rigorous justification for formal perturbative expansions. This theory is applied to several concrete models, including the single pair interaction model and the Pauli-Fierz model in the dipole approximation.
